title: New fields, command line and saved layout
author: claude
summary: New entry fields, new command-line flags, and saved card positions.
what: New fields (kind, parent, order, follows, links, summary, tech, before and after text), matching command-line flags and form fields, and a small service that saves dragged card positions.
why: Part of making the dev log easier to read.
how: The store checks the new fields. `npm run log -- --help` lists the flags and `--tree` prints the entry tree. The layout is saved in `devlog/board-layout.json`.
